proposals.markdown:
### Overview

Marafei proposes  **Tailoredtech BBS(BBS)** platform for Bahri Ship Management, delivered in partnership with TailoredTech.

**Model 1** is Tailoredtech BBS third-party platform provided under an **annual subscription**. The solution is **hosted and owned by Marafei** . The product includes **data migration** and **ongoing maintenance** for the software under the subscription.

### MIPS2 pathway (optional)

Full MIPS2 implementation is quoted separately. An optional **MIPS2 credit** apply if Bahri proceeds with MIPS2 with the annual plan. MIPS2 is **optional** and is **not required** for Model 1 delivery.

### Timeline

| Milestone | Target date |
|-----------|------------|
| Development started | **20 July 2026** |
| Target readiness | **15 October 2026** |
| Small batch releases + UAT | Ongoing until go-live |
| Ready for roll-out | **Before 1 November 2026** |

Work has already started. Before final release there will be **regular small batch releases** for updates and UAT so the product is ready for rolling out before **1 November 2026**.

proposals.markdown:
### Overview

Marafei proposes **Bahri Behavior-Based Safety (BBS)** platform for Bahri Ship Management, delivered in partnership with TailoredTech.

**Model 2** is an Inhouse **one-time implementation** on **Bahri infrastructure**, **Bahri branded**, with **data migration** and **ongoing maintenance** for the software. This solution is **not MIPS2 native**.


### Stack and MIPS2 

The technical stack is **compatible** with the MIPS2 / Azure ecosystem .

**API integration** can be provided for any integrations required with MIPS2 to deliver the **same operational capabilities** expected from native MIPS2 features.


### SSO independence 

The product will be **finished independently** of whether it is integrated with **MIPS SSO**. Once SSO integration is in place, **no transition or migration** of the product itself is required - the same release date remains valid.


### MIPS2 pathway (optional) 

Full MIPS2 implementation is quoted separately. An optional **MIPS2 credit** apply if Bahri proceeds with MIPS2 if proceeded with this plan. MIPS2 is **optional** and is **not required** for Model 2 delivery.



### Timeline 

| Milestone | Date |
|-----------|------|
| Development started | **20 July 2026** |
| Target readiness | **15 October 2026** |
| Regular small batch releases + UAT | Ongoing until go-live |
| Ready for roll-out | **Before 1 November 2026** |

Work has already started. Before final release there will be **regular small batch releases** for updates and UAT so the product is ready for rolling out before **1 November 2026**. Because delivery is independent of MIPS SSO timing, the product can be released on the **same release date** with or without SSO; SSO can follow without product re-migration.
